text: [lang:common]Sanctuary...[/lang] you must find it. My family, they are in the capital. Please, find the [lang:common]Sanctuary[/lang]. For them. [lang:common]Sanctuary.[/lang]
Are you… real?
Yes. I was told you were injured. Can I help?
I nearly lost my leg to a night drake. Unless you have unseen powers, I doubt you can help.
Hello, traveler. The mold in this valley makes my lungs ache.
I long to leave.
Yes
Then come with me!
Ah, come in, come in!
Do you speak the common tongue?
Yes, a bit, a bit. But you won’t get far in Whittlebone without speaking Vyeshal.
Can you tell me about this place?
Our seaside hamlet is sinking… into the mud to the south, or the mist to the east. We haven’t many seasons left. The inn, the seer, the watchfolk, all will be swallowed.
The inn?
Who is this Seer?
Tell me about the watchfolk.
This town is sinking into… the mud?
We have an inn, you’ll smell it surely. The stew is as fermented as the spirits.
We were once famous for our Seer – he still serves us, as we do him.
You must have met Talia if you climbed up from the shore. Her counterpart Jacksaw is at rest. He was injured by a night drake.
Yes… it is the fault of governance by a clairvoyant. All visions of doom and no civic planning.
Tragic… the old city center sank, taking with it our primordial inheritance.
The old city?
Yes yes. I have some old maps here that could help you if you plan to go that way.
Hello, traveler.
No. Ulga.
We saw the shipwreck from the coast. There are rarely survivors on these shores. The mist swallows them.
Praise be the old gods, we still have stores of amber to keep the village lit for a few more seasons. But the mist will take us, that is sure.
I’ve heard tell of it. But if it’s out there it’s beyond beast infested lands. No mudman would make the trek. Our lives are measured in amber.
Do you speak the common tongue?
My ship wrecked off the shore. I need help.
What is this place?
A man on the shore kept saying “Sanctuary”. Do you know what this is?
Hello, traveler.
Can I interest you in some goods?
I’m the innkeeper!
Have you tried the stew? Each bite has 2 perfect golden mushrooms.
Mmm I can’t get enough of this stew. The 1 portion of succulent sparrow meat is my favorite part.
I hear the innkeeper cooks the stew for 6 hours.
Hello.
Salutations.
I’ve been to the swamp. It’s hot.
Who goes there?
I… I don’t know where I am.
Ah, common tongue. You’ve crossed into dangerous lands. But you can rest here in Whittlebone.
Whittlebone?
Yes. The Mist will make this place uninhabitable soon. But it’s safe for now. Not many speak common tongue though. You’d do best to learn our customs. Here, take this.
I am busy now, commoner. I must watch the sea.
Oooh what’s this come crawlin outta the mud I see?
Come a little closer tadpole! Do ya have anything shiny?
Shall we trade?
